'''Konya Suladi''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served in the rank as [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis.]] She was assigned to the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] as a special consultant. She send fellow Imperials looking for signs of [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] teleporter network.<ref name="TOR" />
